root_cause.text: The boundary check in `decode_choice()` before calling `get_len()` uses the uninitialized variable `len` (which is 0) instead of the actual maximum bytes `get_len()` may read (2), allowing an out-of-bounds read when the bitstream buffer is fully consumed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `nf_h323_error_boundary(bs, len, 0)` to `nf_h323_error_boundary(bs, 2, 0)`. The CVE description states that `len` is initialized to 0 and not updated before the check, causing it to pass even when `bs->cur == bs->end`, leading to `get_len()` reading past the buffer.
